citation: Skrhak, Novotny, Feidakis, Krivak, Hoksza. CryptoBench: cryptic protein-ligand binding sites dataset and benchmark. Bioinformatics 41(1):btae745 (2025). doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btae745
split_construction: MMseqs2 clustering at 10% sequence identity; 80:20 train:test; test = 222 apo structures

cryptobench-dataset/folds/test.json.role: test fold membership + apo_pocket_selection cryptic labels

materialization: tools/fetch_official_data.py --build-manifest --fold-file data/cryptobench_apo/_osf/test.json rebuilds official_manifest.json + per-structure receptor/label files (RCSB receptors, chain-scoped, ligand-stripped). SHA-256 of every fetched OSF file is verified against the OSF-reported digest.

evaluable_scope.note: 38 records carry a compound multi-chain apo_chain (e.g. 'M-O-P'); the per-residue metric pipeline indexes residues by chain-agnostic resseq, so those units are excluded to avoid ambiguous labels (documented, not silently dropped).
